title: fix(console): enable MSW in Vercel build so record detail URLs resolve on the demo
body:
⚠️ Previous fix was based on a wrong assumption and has been reverted.

User clarified: **the Vercel deployment of `demo.objectui.org` runs in server mode** (`VITE_USE_MOCK_SERVER=false`) and pulls data from a real ObjectStack backend (`VITE_SERVER_URL`). My earlier commit flipping MSW back on would have replaced real backend data with in-browser seed data — that's not the desired behavior.

## Status
- [x] Revert `6311fdb` — `vercel.json`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` back to server-mode configuration.
- [ ] ⛔ **Blocked:** sandbox cannot reach `demo.objectui.org` or `demo.objectstack.ai` (`ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT` / DNS failure), so I cannot perform the browser test requested. Need either:
  - Network access to the deployed domains granted to this sandbox, **or**
  - A captured network trace (DevTools → Network) for the failing `GET /api/v1/data/crm__account/crm__account-1776695419799-1` request: status code, response body, and whether the record id in the list response matches the id in the failing URL.

## What I can already say from static analysis
The id shape `crm__account-<timestamp>-<seq>` is the in-memory driver's auto-generated id pattern (`<object_full_name>-<Date.now()>-<counter>`). These ids are *not* derived from any stable seed, so they change on every kernel restart. On Vercel, serverless cold starts / redeploys reboot the in-memory driver and regenerate all ids — any URL captured in a previous session (or a cached list response) will 404 on the next `findOne`. This is a strong candidate for the root cause, but needs confirmation from an actual network trace before landing a fix in the right place (likely the backend repo / `apps/server`, not this console SPA).
